items.title: Identity-Based Encryption from the Weil Pairing

code.content:
from charm.toolbox.pairinggroup import PairingGroup, ZR, G1, pair
from hashlib import shake_256


def xor_bytes(a: bytes, b: bytes) -> bytes:
    return bytes(x ^ y for x, y in zip(a, b))


class BonehFranklinIBE:
    def __init__(self, curve="SS512"):
        self.group = PairingGroup(curve)

    def kdf(self, gt_element, length: int) -> bytes:
        """
        H : GT -> {0,1}^n
        用 SHAKE256 将配对群元素映射成指定长度的字节串。
        """
        data = self.group.serialize(gt_element)
        return shake_256(data).digest(length)

    def map_to_point(self, identity: str):
        """
        MapToPoint_G(ID)
        在 Charm 中可以直接将身份哈希到 G1。
        """
        return self.group.hash(identity, G1)

    def setup(self):
        """
        Setup:
        生成系统参数 params 和主密钥 master_key。
        """
        P = self.group.random(G1)
        s = self.group.random(ZR)

        Ppub = P ** s

        params = {
            "P": P,
            "Ppub": Ppub
        }

        master_key = s
        return params, master_key

    def extract(self, master_key, identity: str):
        """
        Extract:
        输入身份 ID，输出对应的私钥 d_ID = sQ_ID。
        """
        Q_ID = self.map_to_point(identity)
        d_ID = Q_ID ** master_key
        return d_ID

    def encrypt(self, params, identity: str, message: bytes):
        """
        Encrypt:
        C = <U, V> = <rP, M xor H(g_ID^r)>
        """
        P = params["P"]
        Ppub = params["Ppub"]

        Q_ID = self.map_to_point(identity)

        r = self.group.random(ZR)

        U = P ** r

        g_ID = pair(Q_ID, Ppub)
        K = g_ID ** r

        pad = self.kdf(K, len(message))
        V = xor_bytes(message, pad)

        ciphertext = {
            "U": U,
            "V": V
        }

        return ciphertext

    def decrypt(self, private_key, ciphertext):
        """
        Decrypt:
        M = V xor H(e(d_ID, U))
        """
        U = ciphertext["U"]
        V = ciphertext["V"]

        K = pair(private_key, U)

        pad = self.kdf(K, len(V))
        message = xor_bytes(V, pad)

        return message


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ibe = BonehFranklinIBE()

    params, master_key = ibe.setup()

    identity = "alice@example.com"
    message = b"This is an implementation of Identity-Based Encryption!"

    private_key = ibe.extract(master_key, identity)

    ciphertext = ibe.encrypt(params, identity, message)

    decrypted = ibe.decrypt(private_key, ciphertext)

    print("Original message: ", message)
    print("Decrypted message:", decrypted)
    print("Success:", message == decrypted)

items.abstract: Boneh 和 Franklin 提出了首个实用的身份基加密（IBE）方案，将任意身份字符串映射为公钥，并由私钥生成中心使用主密钥生成对应身份私钥。该实现整理并复现论文中的 BasicIdent 与 FullIdent 两个核心算法：BasicIdent 展示基于 Weil pairing 的基本加密结构，FullIdent 在此基础上结合 Fujisaki-Okamoto 转换，在随机预言机模型下实现选择密文安全。

algorithmSections.title: BasicIdent
steps: Setup：随机选择生成元 \(P\in G_1\) 和主密钥 \(s\in\mathbb{Z}_q^*\)，计算系统公钥 \(P_{pub}=sP\)，输出公开参数 \(params=(P,P_{pub})\) 与主密钥 \(s\)。Charm-Crypto 中写作 `Ppub = P ** s`。
Extract：对身份 \(ID\) 执行 \(Q_{ID}=\mathrm{MapToPoint}(ID)\)，再计算身份私钥 \(d_{ID}=sQ_{ID}\)。Charm-Crypto 中使用 `group.hash(identity, G1)` 和 `Q_ID ** master_key`。
Encrypt：随机选择 \(r\in\mathbb{Z}_q\)，计算 \(U=rP\)，并计算 \(g_{ID}=\hat{e}(Q_{ID},P_{pub})\)。代码中对应 `U = P ** r` 与 `g_ID = pair(Q_ID, Ppub)`。
Encrypt：计算共享值 \(K=g_{ID}^{r}\)，用 \(H(K)\) 生成与消息等长的掩码，得到 \(V=M\oplus H(g_{ID}^{r})\)，输出密文 \(C=(U,V)\)。
Decrypt：使用身份私钥计算 \(K=\hat{e}(d_{ID},U)\)，再恢复 \(M=V\oplus H(K)\)。
正确性来自双线性：\[\hat{e}(d_{ID},U)=\hat{e}(sQ_{ID},rP)=\hat{e}(Q_{ID},P)^{sr}=\hat{e}(Q_{ID},P_{pub})^r=g_{ID}^{r}.\]

algorithmSections.title: FullIdent
steps: Setup 与 Extract 沿用 BasicIdent，但额外使用 \(H_1:\{0,1\}^n\times\{0,1\}^n\rightarrow\mathbb{F}_q\) 和 \(G_1:\{0,1\}^n\rightarrow\{0,1\}^n\)。
Encrypt：先对身份计算 \(Q_{ID}=\mathrm{MapToPoint}(ID)\)，再随机选择 \(\sigma\in\{0,1\}^n\)。
Encrypt：按照论文的 Fujisaki-Okamoto 转换设置 \(r=H_1(\sigma,M)\)，并计算 \(U=rP\)。代码中 `h1_to_zr(sigma, message)` 用确定性哈希把 \(\sigma,M\) 映射到 \(\mathbb{Z}_q\)。
Encrypt：计算 \(g_{ID}=\hat{e}(Q_{ID},P_{pub})\)，然后生成 \(V=\sigma\oplus H(g_{ID}^{r})\) 和 \(W=M\oplus G_1(\sigma)\)。
Encrypt：输出 FullIdent 密文 \(C=(U,V,W)=(rP,\sigma\oplus H(g_{ID}^{r}),M\oplus G_1(\sigma))\)。
Decrypt：先计算 \(\sigma=V\oplus H(\hat{e}(d_{ID},U))\)，再计算 \(M=W\oplus G_1(\sigma)\)。
Decrypt：重新计算 \(r=H_1(\sigma,M)\)，检查 \(U\stackrel{?}{=}rP\)。若检查失败则拒绝密文；这是 FullIdent 获得选择密文安全性的关键步骤。

algorithmSections.title: Escrow ElGamal Encryption
steps: Setup：随机选择生成元 \(P\in G_1\) 与全局托管密钥 \(s\in\mathbb{Z}_q\)，计算 \(Q=sP\)。公开参数为 \(params=(P,Q,H)\)，托管密钥为 \(s\)。Charm-Crypto 中写作 `Q = P ** s`。
KeyGen：用户随机选择私钥 \(x\in\mathbb{Z}_q\)，计算公钥 \(P_{pub}=xP\)。私钥是 \(x\)，公钥是 \(P_{pub}\)。
Encrypt：随机选择 \(r\in\mathbb{Z}_q\)，计算 \(U=rP\)，并令 \(g=\hat{e}(P_{pub},Q)\)。
Encrypt：计算 \(V=M\oplus H(g^r)\)，输出密文 \(C=(U,V)=(rP,M\oplus H(g^r))\)。
Decrypt：普通用户用私钥 \(x\) 计算 \(M=V\oplus H(\hat{e}(U,xQ))\)。代码中 \(xQ\) 写作 `Q ** private_key`。
Escrow-decrypt：托管方用全局托管密钥 \(s\) 计算 \(M=V\oplus H(\hat{e}(U,sP_{pub}))\)。代码中 \(sP_{pub}\) 写作 `public_key ** escrow_key`。
正确性来自双线性：\[\hat{e}(U,xQ)=\hat{e}(rP,xsP)=\hat{e}(xP,sP)^r=\hat{e}(P_{pub},Q)^r=g^r.\] 同理，\(\hat{e}(U,sP_{pub})\) 也得到同一个共享值。

steps: Setup：随机选择生成元 \(P\in G_1\) 和主密钥 \(s\in\mathbb{Z}_q^*\)，计算系统公钥 \(P_{pub}=sP\)，输出公开参数 \(params=(P,P_{pub})\) 与主密钥 \(s\)。Charm-Crypto 中写作 `Ppub = P ** s`。

Encrypt：随机选择 \(r\in\mathbb{Z}_q\)，计算 \(U=rP\)，并计算 \(g_{ID}=\hat{e}(Q_{ID},P_{pub})\)。代码中对应 `U = P ** r` 与 `g_ID = pair(Q_ID, Ppub)`。
Encrypt：计算共享值 \(K=g_{ID}^{r}\)，用 \(H(K)\) 生成与消息等长的掩码，得到 \(V=M\oplus H(g_{ID}^{r})\)，输出密文 \(C=(U,V)\)。
Decrypt：使用身份私钥计算 \(K=\hat{e}(d_{ID},U)\)，再恢复 \(M=V\oplus H(K)\)。

import os
from charm.toolbox.pairinggroup import PairingGroup, ZR, G1, pair
from hashlib import shake_256


def xor_bytes(a: bytes, b: bytes) -> bytes:
    return bytes(x ^ y for x, y in zip(a, b))


def encode_bytes(*parts: bytes) -> bytes:
    encoded = b""
    for part in parts:
        encoded += len(part).to_bytes(4, "big") + part
    return encoded


class BonehFranklinFullIdent:
    def __init__(self, curve="SS512", sigma_length: int = 32):
        self.group = PairingGroup(curve)
        self.sigma_length = sigma_length

    def kdf(self, gt_element, length: int) -> bytes:
        """
        H : GT -> {0,1}^n
        用 SHAKE256 将配对群元素映射成指定长度的字节串。
        """
        data = self.group.serialize(gt_element)
        return shake_256(data).digest(length)

    def g1_hash(self, sigma: bytes, length: int) -> bytes:
        """
        G_1 : {0,1}^n -> {0,1}^n
        用于从 sigma 派生加密消息 M 的字节流。
        """
        return shake_256(b"BF-FullIdent-G1" + sigma).digest(length)

    def h1_to_zr(self, sigma: bytes, message: bytes):
        """
        H_1 : {0,1}^n x {0,1}^n -> Z_q
        根据论文，FullIdent 中的 r 由 sigma 和 M 确定。
        """
        seed = b"BF-FullIdent-H1" + encode_bytes(sigma, message)
        digest = shake_256(seed).digest(64)
        return self.group.hash(digest, ZR)

    def map_to_point(self, identity: str):
        """
        MapToPoint_G(ID)
        在 Charm 中可以直接将身份哈希到 G1。
        """
        return self.group.hash(identity, G1)

    def setup(self):
        """
        Setup:
        与 BasicIdent 相同，但 FullIdent 额外使用 H_1 和 G_1。
        """
        P = self.group.random(G1)
        s = self.group.random(ZR)

        Ppub = P ** s

        params = {
            "P": P,
            "Ppub": Ppub
        }

        master_key = s
        return params, master_key

    def extract(self, master_key, identity: str):
        """
        Extract:
        输入身份 ID，输出对应的私钥 d_ID = sQ_ID。
        """
        Q_ID = self.map_to_point(identity)
        d_ID = Q_ID ** master_key
        return d_ID

    def encrypt(self, params, identity: str, message: bytes):
        """
        Encrypt:
        C = <U, V, W> = <rP, sigma xor H(g_ID^r), M xor G_1(sigma)>
        其中 r = H_1(sigma, M)。
        """
        P = params["P"]
        Ppub = params["Ppub"]

        Q_ID = self.map_to_point(identity)

        sigma = os.urandom(self.sigma_length)
        r = self.h1_to_zr(sigma, message)

        U = P ** r

        g_ID = pair(Q_ID, Ppub)
        K = g_ID ** r

        V = xor_bytes(sigma, self.kdf(K, self.sigma_length))
        W = xor_bytes(message, self.g1_hash(sigma, len(message)))

        ciphertext = {
            "U": U,
            "V": V,
            "W": W
        }

        return ciphertext

    def decrypt(self, params, private_key, ciphertext):
        """
        Decrypt:
        先恢复 sigma 和 M，然后重新计算 r 并检查 U = rP。
        """
        P = params["P"]

        U = ciphertext["U"]
        V = ciphertext["V"]
        W = ciphertext["W"]

        K = pair(private_key, U)

        sigma = xor_bytes(V, self.kdf(K, len(V)))
        message = xor_bytes(W, self.g1_hash(sigma, len(W)))

        r = self.h1_to_zr(sigma, message)
        if U != P ** r:
            raise ValueError("invalid ciphertext: U != rP")

        return message


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ibe = BonehFranklinFullIdent()

    params, master_key = ibe.setup()

    identity = "alice@example.com"
    message = b"This is an implementation of FullIdent IBE!"

    private_key = ibe.extract(master_key, identity)

    ciphertext = ibe.encrypt(params, identity, message)

    decrypted = ibe.decrypt(params, private_key, ciphertext)

    print("Original message: ", message)
    print("Decrypted message:", decrypted)
    print("Success:", message == decrypted)

    tampered = dict(ciphertext)
    tampered["W"] = bytes([tampered["W"][0] ^ 1]) + tampered["W"][1:]

    try:
        ibe.decrypt(params, private_key, tampered)
    except ValueError as error:
        print("Tampered ciphertext rejected:", error)

algorithms.title: Escrow ElGamal Encryption
steps: Setup：随机选择生成元 \(P\in G_1\) 与全局托管密钥 \(s\in\mathbb{Z}_q\)，计算 \(Q=sP\)。公开参数为 \(params=(P,Q,H)\)，托管密钥为 \(s\)。Charm-Crypto 中写作 `Q = P ** s`。
KeyGen：用户随机选择私钥 \(x\in\mathbb{Z}_q\)，计算公钥 \(P_{pub}=xP\)。私钥是 \(x\)，公钥是 \(P_{pub}\)。
Encrypt：随机选择 \(r\in\mathbb{Z}_q\)，计算 \(U=rP\)，并令 \(g=\hat{e}(P_{pub},Q)\)。
Encrypt：计算 \(V=M\oplus H(g^r)\)，输出密文 \(C=(U,V)=(rP,M\oplus H(g^r))\)。
Decrypt：普通用户用私钥 \(x\) 计算 \(M=V\oplus H(\hat{e}(U,xQ))\)。代码中 \(xQ\) 写作 `Q ** private_key`。
Escrow-decrypt：托管方用全局托管密钥 \(s\) 计算 \(M=V\oplus H(\hat{e}(U,sP_{pub}))\)。代码中 \(sP_{pub}\) 写作 `public_key ** escrow_key`。
正确性来自双线性：\[\hat{e}(U,xQ)=\hat{e}(rP,xsP)=\hat{e}(xP,sP)^r=\hat{e}(P_{pub},Q)^r=g^r.\] 同理，\(\hat{e}(U,sP_{pub})\) 也得到同一个共享值。

code.content:
from charm.toolbox.pairinggroup import PairingGroup, ZR, G1, pair
from hashlib import shake_256


def xor_bytes(a: bytes, b: bytes) -> bytes:
    return bytes(x ^ y for x, y in zip(a, b))


class EscrowElGamalEncryption:
    def __init__(self, curve="SS512"):
        self.group = PairingGroup(curve)

    def kdf(self, gt_element, length: int) -> bytes:
        """
        H : GT -> {0,1}^n
        用 SHAKE256 将配对群元素映射成指定长度的字节串。
        """
        data = self.group.serialize(gt_element)
        return shake_256(data).digest(length)

    def setup(self):
        """
        Setup:
        生成系统参数 params 和全局托管密钥 escrow_key。
        论文记号为 Q = sP；Charm 中写作 Q = P ** s。
        """
        P = self.group.random(G1)
        s = self.group.random(ZR)

        Q = P ** s

        params = {
            "P": P,
            "Q": Q
        }

        escrow_key = s
        return params, escrow_key

    def keygen(self, params):
        """
        KeyGen:
        用户生成自己的 ElGamal 公私钥对。
        """
        P = params["P"]

        x = self.group.random(ZR)
        Ppub = P ** x

        public_key = Ppub
        private_key = x
        return public_key, private_key

    def encrypt(self, params, public_key, message: bytes):
        """
        Encrypt:
        C = <U, V> = <rP, M xor H(g^r)>
        其中 g = e(Ppub, Q)。
        """
        P = params["P"]
        Q = params["Q"]

        r = self.group.random(ZR)

        U = P ** r

        g = pair(public_key, Q)
        K = g ** r

        pad = self.kdf(K, len(message))
        V = xor_bytes(message, pad)

        ciphertext = {
            "U": U,
            "V": V
        }

        return ciphertext

    def decrypt(self, params, private_key, ciphertext):
        """
        Decrypt:
        用户使用私钥 x 计算 M = V xor H(e(U, xQ))。
        Charm 中 xQ 写作 Q ** x。
        """
        Q = params["Q"]

        U = ciphertext["U"]
        V = ciphertext["V"]

        K = pair(U, Q ** private_key)

        pad = self.kdf(K, len(V))
        message = xor_bytes(V, pad)

        return message

    def escrow_decrypt(self, public_key, escrow_key, ciphertext):
        """
        Escrow-decrypt:
        托管方使用全局托管密钥 s 计算 M = V xor H(e(U, sPpub))。
        Charm 中 sPpub 写作 Ppub ** s。
        """
        U = ciphertext["U"]
        V = ciphertext["V"]

        K = pair(U, public_key ** escrow_key)

        pad = self.kdf(K, len(V))
        message = xor_bytes(V, pad)

        return message


if __name__ == "__main__":
    scheme = EscrowElGamalEncryption()

    params, escrow_key = scheme.setup()

    public_key, private_key = scheme.keygen(params)

    message = b"This is an implementation of Escrow ElGamal Encryption!"

    ciphertext = scheme.encrypt(params, public_key, message)

    decrypted_by_user = scheme.decrypt(params, private_key, ciphertext)
    decrypted_by_escrow = scheme.escrow_decrypt(public_key, escrow_key, ciphertext)

    print("Original message:     ", message)
    print("User decrypt:         ", decrypted_by_user)
    print("Escrow decrypt:       ", decrypted_by_escrow)
    print("User success:         ", message == decrypted_by_user)
    print("Escrow success:       ", message == decrypted_by_escrow)

code.content:
from charm.toolbox.pairinggroup import PairingGroup, ZR, G1, pair
from hashlib import shake_256


def xor_bytes(a: bytes, b: bytes) -> bytes:
    return bytes(x ^ y for x, y in zip(a, b))


class BonehFranklinIBE:
    def __init__(self, curve="SS512"):
        self.group = PairingGroup(curve)

    def kdf(self, gt_element, length: int) -> bytes:
        """
        H : GT -> {0,1}^n
        用 SHAKE256 将配对群元素映射成指定长度的字节串。
        """
        data = self.group.serialize(gt_element)
        return shake_256(data).digest(length)

    def map_to_point(self, identity: str):
        """
        MapToPoint_G(ID)
        在 Charm 中可以直接将身份哈希到 G1。
        """
        return self.group.hash(identity, G1)

    def setup(self):
        """
        Setup:
        生成系统参数 params 和主密钥 master_key。
        """
        P = self.group.random(G1)
        s = self.group.random(ZR)

        Ppub = P ** s

        params = {
            "P": P,
            "Ppub": Ppub
        }

        master_key = s
        return params, master_key

    def extract(self, master_key, identity: str):
        """
        Extract:
        输入身份 ID，输出对应的私钥 d_ID = sQ_ID。
        """
        Q_ID = self.map_to_point(identity)
        d_ID = Q_ID ** master_key
        return d_ID

    def encrypt(self, params, identity: str, message: bytes):
        """
        Encrypt:
        C = <U, V> = <rP, M xor H(g_ID^r)>
        """
        P = params["P"]
        Ppub = params["Ppub"]

        Q_ID = self.map_to_point(identity)

        r = self.group.random(ZR)

        U = P ** r

        g_ID = pair(Q_ID, Ppub)
        K = g_ID ** r

        pad = self.kdf(K, len(message))
        V = xor_bytes(message, pad)

        ciphertext = {
            "U": U,
            "V": V
        }

        return ciphertext

    def decrypt(self, private_key, ciphertext):
        """
        Decrypt:
        M = V xor H(e(d_ID, U))
        """
        U = ciphertext["U"]
        V = ciphertext["V"]

        K = pair(private_key, U)

        pad = self.kdf(K, len(V))
        message = xor_bytes(V, pad)

        return message


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ibe = BonehFranklinIBE()

    params, master_key = ibe.setup()

    identity = "alice@example.com"
    message = b"This is an implementation of Identity-Based Encryption!"

    private_key = ibe.extract(master_key, identity)

    ciphertext = ibe.encrypt(params, identity, message)

    decrypted = ibe.decrypt(private_key, ciphertext)

    print("Original message: ", message)
    print("Decrypted message:", decrypted)
    print("Success:", message == decrypted)

items.abstract: Boneh and Franklin introduced the first practical identity-based encryption (IBE) scheme, where an arbitrary identity string can serve as a public key and a private-key generator derives the corresponding secret key from a master secret. This implementation reproduces the two core constructions from the paper: BasicIdent, which shows the pairing-based IBE mechanism, and FullIdent, which applies the Fujisaki-Okamoto transform to obtain chosen-ciphertext security in the random oracle model.

algorithmSections.title: BasicIdent
steps: Setup: sample a generator \(P\in G_1\) and a master secret \(s\in\mathbb{Z}_q^*\), compute \(P_{pub}=sP\), and output public parameters \(params=(P,P_{pub})\) with master secret \(s\). In Charm-Crypto this is `Ppub = P ** s`.
Extract: map the identity \(ID\) to \(Q_{ID}=\mathrm{MapToPoint}(ID)\), then compute the identity private key \(d_{ID}=sQ_{ID}\). The code uses `group.hash(identity, G1)` and `Q_ID ** master_key`.
Encrypt: sample \(r\in\mathbb{Z}_q\), compute \(U=rP\), and compute \(g_{ID}=\hat{e}(Q_{ID},P_{pub})\). The code uses `U = P ** r` and `g_ID = pair(Q_ID, Ppub)`.
Encrypt: compute \(K=g_{ID}^{r}\), derive a message-length mask from \(H(K)\), set \(V=M\oplus H(g_{ID}^{r})\), and output \(C=(U,V)\).
Decrypt: use the identity private key to compute \(K=\hat{e}(d_{ID},U)\), then recover \(M=V\oplus H(K)\).
Correctness follows from bilinearity: \[\hat{e}(d_{ID},U)=\hat{e}(sQ_{ID},rP)=\hat{e}(Q_{ID},P)^{sr}=\hat{e}(Q_{ID},P_{pub})^r=g_{ID}^{r}.\]

algorithmSections.title: FullIdent
steps: Setup and Extract are inherited from BasicIdent, with two additional hash functions \(H_1:\{0,1\}^n\times\{0,1\}^n\rightarrow\mathbb{F}_q\) and \(G_1:\{0,1\}^n\rightarrow\{0,1\}^n\).
Encrypt: compute \(Q_{ID}=\mathrm{MapToPoint}(ID)\), then sample a random \(\sigma\in\{0,1\}^n\).
Encrypt: set \(r=H_1(\sigma,M)\) according to the Fujisaki-Okamoto transform, then compute \(U=rP\). In code, `h1_to_zr(sigma, message)` deterministically maps \(\sigma,M\) into \(\mathbb{Z}_q\).
Encrypt: compute \(g_{ID}=\hat{e}(Q_{ID},P_{pub})\), then derive \(V=\sigma\oplus H(g_{ID}^{r})\) and \(W=M\oplus G_1(\sigma)\).
Encrypt: output the FullIdent ciphertext \(C=(U,V,W)=(rP,\sigma\oplus H(g_{ID}^{r}),M\oplus G_1(\sigma))\).
Decrypt: first compute \(\sigma=V\oplus H(\hat{e}(d_{ID},U))\), then recover \(M=W\oplus G_1(\sigma)\).
Decrypt: recompute \(r=H_1(\sigma,M)\) and check \(U\stackrel{?}{=}rP\). If the check fails, reject the ciphertext; this is the key step that gives FullIdent chosen-ciphertext security.

algorithmSections.title: Escrow ElGamal Encryption
steps: Setup: sample a generator \(P\in G_1\) and a global escrow key \(s\in\mathbb{Z}_q\), then compute \(Q=sP\). The public parameters are \(params=(P,Q,H)\), and the escrow key is \(s\). In Charm-Crypto this is `Q = P ** s`.
KeyGen: a user samples a private key \(x\in\mathbb{Z}_q\) and computes the public key \(P_{pub}=xP\). The private key is \(x\), and the public key is \(P_{pub}\).
Encrypt: sample \(r\in\mathbb{Z}_q\), compute \(U=rP\), and set \(g=\hat{e}(P_{pub},Q)\).
Encrypt: compute \(V=M\oplus H(g^r)\), and output \(C=(U,V)=(rP,M\oplus H(g^r))\).
Decrypt: the user computes \(M=V\oplus H(\hat{e}(U,xQ))\) with private key \(x\). In code, \(xQ\) is `Q ** private_key`.
Escrow-decrypt: the escrow agent computes \(M=V\oplus H(\hat{e}(U,sP_{pub}))\) with the global escrow key \(s\). In code, \(sP_{pub}\) is `public_key ** escrow_key`.
Correctness follows from bilinearity: \[\hat{e}(U,xQ)=\hat{e}(rP,xsP)=\hat{e}(xP,sP)^r=\hat{e}(P_{pub},Q)^r=g^r.\] Likewise, \(\hat{e}(U,sP_{pub})\) produces the same shared value.

steps: Setup: sample a generator \(P\in G_1\) and a master secret \(s\in\mathbb{Z}_q^*\), compute \(P_{pub}=sP\), and output public parameters \(params=(P,P_{pub})\) with master secret \(s\). In Charm-Crypto this is `Ppub = P ** s`.

Decrypt: use the identity private key to compute \(K=\hat{e}(d_{ID},U)\), then recover \(M=V\oplus H(K)\).

import os
from charm.toolbox.pairinggroup import PairingGroup, ZR, G1, pair
from hashlib import shake_256


def xor_bytes(a: bytes, b: bytes) -> bytes:
    return bytes(x ^ y for x, y in zip(a, b))


def encode_bytes(*parts: bytes) -> bytes:
    encoded = b""
    for part in parts:
        encoded += len(part).to_bytes(4, "big") + part
    return encoded


class BonehFranklinFullIdent:
    def __init__(self, curve="SS512", sigma_length: int = 32):
        self.group = PairingGroup(curve)
        self.sigma_length = sigma_length

    def kdf(self, gt_element, length: int) -> bytes:
        """
        H : GT -> {0,1}^n
        用 SHAKE256 将配对群元素映射成指定长度的字节串。
        """
        data = self.group.serialize(gt_element)
        return shake_256(data).digest(length)

    def g1_hash(self, sigma: bytes, length: int) -> bytes:
        """
        G_1 : {0,1}^n -> {0,1}^n
        用于从 sigma 派生加密消息 M 的字节流。
        """
        return shake_256(b"BF-FullIdent-G1" + sigma).digest(length)

    def h1_to_zr(self, sigma: bytes, message: bytes):
        """
        H_1 : {0,1}^n x {0,1}^n -> Z_q
        根据论文，FullIdent 中的 r 由 sigma 和 M 确定。
        """
        seed = b"BF-FullIdent-H1" + encode_bytes(sigma, message)
        digest = shake_256(seed).digest(64)
        return self.group.hash(digest, ZR)

    def map_to_point(self, identity: str):
        """
        MapToPoint_G(ID)
        在 Charm 中可以直接将身份哈希到 G1。
        """
        return self.group.hash(identity, G1)

    def setup(self):
        """
        Setup:
        与 BasicIdent 相同，但 FullIdent 额外使用 H_1 和 G_1。
        """
        P = self.group.random(G1)
        s = self.group.random(ZR)

        Ppub = P ** s

        params = {
            "P": P,
            "Ppub": Ppub
        }

        master_key = s
        return params, master_key

    def extract(self, master_key, identity: str):
        """
        Extract:
        输入身份 ID，输出对应的私钥 d_ID = sQ_ID。
        """
        Q_ID = self.map_to_point(identity)
        d_ID = Q_ID ** master_key
        return d_ID

    def encrypt(self, params, identity: str, message: bytes):
        """
        Encrypt:
        C = <U, V, W> = <rP, sigma xor H(g_ID^r), M xor G_1(sigma)>
        其中 r = H_1(sigma, M)。
        """
        P = params["P"]
        Ppub = params["Ppub"]

        Q_ID = self.map_to_point(identity)

        sigma = os.urandom(self.sigma_length)
        r = self.h1_to_zr(sigma, message)

        U = P ** r

        g_ID = pair(Q_ID, Ppub)
        K = g_ID ** r

        V = xor_bytes(sigma, self.kdf(K, self.sigma_length))
        W = xor_bytes(message, self.g1_hash(sigma, len(message)))

        ciphertext = {
            "U": U,
            "V": V,
            "W": W
        }

        return ciphertext

    def decrypt(self, params, private_key, ciphertext):
        """
        Decrypt:
        先恢复 sigma 和 M，然后重新计算 r 并检查 U = rP。
        """
        P = params["P"]

        U = ciphertext["U"]
        V = ciphertext["V"]
        W = ciphertext["W"]

        K = pair(private_key, U)

        sigma = xor_bytes(V, self.kdf(K, len(V)))
        message = xor_bytes(W, self.g1_hash(sigma, len(W)))

        r = self.h1_to_zr(sigma, message)
        if U != P ** r:
            raise ValueError("invalid ciphertext: U != rP")

        return message


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ibe = BonehFranklinFullIdent()

    params, master_key = ibe.setup()

    identity = "alice@example.com"
    message = b"This is an implementation of FullIdent IBE!"

    private_key = ibe.extract(master_key, identity)

    ciphertext = ibe.encrypt(params, identity, message)

    decrypted = ibe.decrypt(params, private_key, ciphertext)

    print("Original message: ", message)
    print("Decrypted message:", decrypted)
    print("Success:", message == decrypted)

    tampered = dict(ciphertext)
    tampered["W"] = bytes([tampered["W"][0] ^ 1]) + tampered["W"][1:]

    try:
        ibe.decrypt(params, private_key, tampered)
    except ValueError as error:
        print("Tampered ciphertext rejected:", error)

algorithms.title: Escrow ElGamal Encryption
steps: Setup: sample a generator \(P\in G_1\) and a global escrow key \(s\in\mathbb{Z}_q\), then compute \(Q=sP\). The public parameters are \(params=(P,Q,H)\), and the escrow key is \(s\). In Charm-Crypto this is `Q = P ** s`.
KeyGen: a user samples a private key \(x\in\mathbb{Z}_q\) and computes the public key \(P_{pub}=xP\). The private key is \(x\), and the public key is \(P_{pub}\).
Encrypt: sample \(r\in\mathbb{Z}_q\), compute \(U=rP\), and set \(g=\hat{e}(P_{pub},Q)\).
Encrypt: compute \(V=M\oplus H(g^r)\), and output \(C=(U,V)=(rP,M\oplus H(g^r))\).
Decrypt: the user computes \(M=V\oplus H(\hat{e}(U,xQ))\) with private key \(x\). In code, \(xQ\) is `Q ** private_key`.
Escrow-decrypt: the escrow agent computes \(M=V\oplus H(\hat{e}(U,sP_{pub}))\) with the global escrow key \(s\). In code, \(sP_{pub}\) is `public_key ** escrow_key`.
Correctness follows from bilinearity: \[\hat{e}(U,xQ)=\hat{e}(rP,xsP)=\hat{e}(xP,sP)^r=\hat{e}(P_{pub},Q)^r=g^r.\] Likewise, \(\hat{e}(U,sP_{pub})\) produces the same shared value.

from charm.toolbox.pairinggroup import PairingGroup, ZR, G1, pair
from hashlib import shake_256


def xor_bytes(a: bytes, b: bytes) -> bytes:
    return bytes(x ^ y for x, y in zip(a, b))


class EscrowElGamalEncryption:
    def __init__(self, curve="SS512"):
        self.group = PairingGroup(curve)

    def kdf(self, gt_element, length: int) -> bytes:
        """
        H : GT -> {0,1}^n
        用 SHAKE256 将配对群元素映射成指定长度的字节串。
        """
        data = self.group.serialize(gt_element)
        return shake_256(data).digest(length)

    def setup(self):
        """
        Setup:
        生成系统参数 params 和全局托管密钥 escrow_key。
        论文记号为 Q = sP；Charm 中写作 Q = P ** s。
        """
        P = self.group.random(G1)
        s = self.group.random(ZR)

        Q = P ** s

        params = {
            "P": P,
            "Q": Q
        }

        escrow_key = s
        return params, escrow_key

    def keygen(self, params):
        """
        KeyGen:
        用户生成自己的 ElGamal 公私钥对。
        """
        P = params["P"]

        x = self.group.random(ZR)
        Ppub = P ** x

        public_key = Ppub
        private_key = x
        return public_key, private_key

    def encrypt(self, params, public_key, message: bytes):
        """
        Encrypt:
        C = <U, V> = <rP, M xor H(g^r)>
        其中 g = e(Ppub, Q)。
        """
        P = params["P"]
        Q = params["Q"]

        r = self.group.random(ZR)

        U = P ** r

        g = pair(public_key, Q)
        K = g ** r

        pad = self.kdf(K, len(message))
        V = xor_bytes(message, pad)

        ciphertext = {
            "U": U,
            "V": V
        }

        return ciphertext

    def decrypt(self, params, private_key, ciphertext):
        """
        Decrypt:
        用户使用私钥 x 计算 M = V xor H(e(U, xQ))。
        Charm 中 xQ 写作 Q ** x。
        """
        Q = params["Q"]

        U = ciphertext["U"]
        V = ciphertext["V"]

        K = pair(U, Q ** private_key)

        pad = self.kdf(K, len(V))
        message = xor_bytes(V, pad)

        return message

    def escrow_decrypt(self, public_key, escrow_key, ciphertext):
        """
        Escrow-decrypt:
        托管方使用全局托管密钥 s 计算 M = V xor H(e(U, sPpub))。
        Charm 中 sPpub 写作 Ppub ** s。
        """
        U = ciphertext["U"]
        V = ciphertext["V"]

        K = pair(U, public_key ** escrow_key)

        pad = self.kdf(K, len(V))
        message = xor_bytes(V, pad)

        return message


if __name__ == "__main__":
    scheme = EscrowElGamalEncryption()

    params, escrow_key = scheme.setup()

    public_key, private_key = scheme.keygen(params)

    message = b"This is an implementation of Escrow ElGamal Encryption!"

    ciphertext = scheme.encrypt(params, public_key, message)

    decrypted_by_user = scheme.decrypt(params, private_key, ciphertext)
    decrypted_by_escrow = scheme.escrow_decrypt(public_key, escrow_key, ciphertext)

    print("Original message:     ", message)
    print("User decrypt:         ", decrypted_by_user)
    print("Escrow decrypt:       ", decrypted_by_escrow)
    print("User success:         ", message == decrypted_by_user)
    print("Escrow success:       ", message == decrypted_by_escrow)
